saved_evidence.title: No Parking in Bicycle Lanes: parking locations poster, English
saved_evidence.description: The City's education poster shows, lane arrangement by lane arrangement, where a vehicle may and may not park where a bicycle lane is present, so that drivers can tell a legal parking location from an obstruction of the bike lane.
saved_evidence.evidence: Headed Parking Locations - No Parking in Bicycle Lanes, over a series of labelled cross sections of vehicle lane, bicycle lane, shared lane and parking arrangements.

cross_listings.reason: It implements the City's bicycle network planning.

text_excerpts.1:
Parking Locations - 
No Parking in Bicycle Lanes
Stopping in a bicycle lane, even for just a little bit, can be very dangerous for someone on a bicycle. 
Always be sure to stop or park your car in a designated parking or loading space and never block or 
stop in the bike lane. Effective December 19, 2018 and per Section 8-5-1-1 of the Traffic Code, stopping, 
standing, or parking is prohibited in bicycle lanes, and may result in a ticket.

text_excerpts.1:
Zonas de Estacionamiento  - 
No Estacionarse en los Carriles de Bicicletas
Detenerse en un carril de bicicletas, aunque sea por un periodo muy corto, puede ocasionar muchos peligros para 
una persona que pasa en bicicleta. Asegúrese de solo detenerse o estacionar su vehículo en una plaza designada 
para el estacionamiento o para la carga, y nunca detenerse dentro de, ni bloquear, el carril de bicicletas. A partir del 
día 19 de diciembre de 2018, según el Inciso 8-5-1-1 del Código de Circulación, será prohibido detenerse, pararse o 
estacionarse en los carriles de bicicletas y el hacerlo puede resultar en infracciones.
